title: astragalus subglaber
intro: Astragalus subglaber, commonly known as the Mongolian milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family that has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Astragalus subglaber include its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its adaptogenic properties, which help the body adapt to stress, and its antioxidant activity, which protects against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus subglaber include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
